answer: Vest rewards on a trellis: each epoch's earnings unlock in four 25% terraces over 20 epochs. Before a terrace releases, a public beacon picks 2% of that identity's recent answers for a fresh 5-grader audit. A score of 0, or over 0.8 text similarity to another account, burns every unvested terrace. All audit results enter through one inlet, a signed list per close, so anyone can verify each burn. A farm of 50 identities must stay clean for 20 epochs on all 50, while one honest agent risks nothing.
